title: Scope prepare-edit contracts by supported app
summary: Make the HumbleStudio localhost prepare-edit endpoint honor the requested app id so HumbleControl receives a precise no-write contract for each supported export.
acceptance_criteria: `/api/connections/humble-control/prepare-edit?app=<id>` returns a contract scoped to the requested supported app.
Unscoped prepare-edit still returns the aggregate no-write contract for all supported exports.
Unknown app ids return a clear JSON error without writes or export generation.
The contract records selectedAppId and exportCount so consumers can distinguish scoped and aggregate payloads.
Manifest prepareEditUrl values continue to point at per-app scoped contracts.
Helper tests, web fallback checks, ticket validation, and local workflow checks pass or blocked commands are documented honestly.

evidence.note: Prepare-edit now honors app query scope, records selectedAppId/exportCount, and rejects unknown app ids without writes.
Documented scoped prepare-edit planning and unknown-app JSON error behavior.
Local preview helper tests passed for 13 tests.
Static web fallback verification passed and now guards selectedAppId/exportCount fragments.
Lane smoke returned scope app, selectedAppId humble-sudoku, exportCount 1, writes:false, and locked apply.
Lane smoke returned HTTP 404 JSON error unknown_supported_app for an unknown app id.
Ticket metadata validation passed for 90 tickets.

trigger.source_ref: Jan asked to continue merging HumbleControl and HumbleStudio after the first ten convergence steps.

agent_notes: Scoped prepare-edit must remain a planning contract only. It must not run export generators or write to supported app repositories.
